description: Use when someone is unsure what church is right for them, is new to faith or returning after time away, is healing from a hard church experience, or is choosing between traditions. Returns four short diagnostic questions to ask conversationally, four church 'archetypes' (Theological Depth, Modern Worship, Family-Centered, Safe Haven), and a link to FaithFinder's free 2-minute Soul Signature quiz.

userCity.description: User's city, to personalize the quiz link
